name: PMEGP — Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme
authority: KVIC / Ministry of MSME, Govt of India
summary: Flagship credit-linked capital subsidy granting 15% to 35% margin money on project loans up to ₹50 Lakhs (Manufacturing) and ₹20 Lakhs (Service/Retail).
key_benefits: Up to 35% Direct Non-Repayable Capital Subsidy
Only 5% to 10% Own Equity Contribution required
Bank Finance up to 90-95% of total project cost
why_template: As a {category} enterprise in {sector} with ₹{turnover}L turnover, you qualify for up to 35% direct subsidy on machinery and expansion loans.

name: CGTMSE — Credit Guarantee Fund Trust for Micro & Small Enterprises
summary: Enables scheduled commercial banks and NBFCs to provide 100% collateral-free term loans and working capital credit facilities up to ₹5 Crore.
documents_needed: Last 2 Years Audited Financials / Balance Sheet
key_benefits: 100% Collateral-Free Credit up to ₹500 Lakhs
85% Sovereign Guarantee Coverage for Micro units
Discounted guarantee fee for Women & SC/ST entrepreneurs
why_template: Collateral-free credit up to ₹5 Crore is unlocked for your {category} enterprise to fund working capital and inventory buffers.

name: Tamil Nadu NEEDS — New Entrepreneur-cum-Enterprise Development Scheme
authority: MSME Department, Government of Tamil Nadu
summary: State-sponsored flagship scheme for first-generation entrepreneurs in Tamil Nadu providing 25% capital subsidy up to ₹75 Lakhs and 3% interest rebate.
collateral_required: CGTMSE Coverage / Minimal Fixed Asset Charge
documents_needed: Land / Factory Lease or Ownership Agreement
key_benefits: 25% Capital Subsidy up to ₹75 Lakhs
3% Rebate on Bank Term Loan Interest
Entrepreneurship Development Programme (EDP) training
why_template: As a Tamil Nadu-based {category} enterprise, you unlock ₹75 Lakhs state capital subsidy + 3% interest discount.

name: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana (PMMY)
authority: National Credit Guarantee Trustee Co / Ministry of Finance
summary: Provides collateral-free institutional micro-credit up to ₹10 Lakhs across Shishu (up to ₹50k), Kishore (₹50k-₹5L), and Tarun (₹5L-₹10L) tiers.
documents_needed: Quotation of Machinery / Stock to be purchased
key_benefits: No Collateral / Margin Money for Shishu loans
Overdraft & Working Capital MUDRA Card provided
Fastest sanction turnaround across PSU & Private banks
why_template: Your {sector} business is directly eligible for Tarun tier (up to ₹10L) with zero collateral requirements.

name: PM Vishwakarma Artisan & Craftsman Scheme
authority: Ministry of MSME, Govt of India
summary: Holistic end-to-end support for traditional artisans and weavers with ₹15,000 modern toolkit grant, skill training, and subsidized 5% interest loans up to ₹3 Lakhs.
documents_needed: Artisan Verification by Gram Panchayat / ULB
key_benefits: ₹15,000 Direct Toolkit Incentive Grant
5% Fixed Concessional Interest Rate (Govt subvention up to 8%)
Digital Transaction Cashback of ₹1 per transaction
why_template: Handloom and artisan producers get ₹15k direct toolkit grant and 5% ultra-low interest loans.

name: Stand-Up India Scheme for Women & SC/ST Entrepreneurs
summary: Bank term and working capital loans between ₹10 Lakhs and ₹1 Crore for setting up greenfield trading, manufacturing, or service ventures by Women or SC/ST promoters.
documents_needed: Proof of 51% Woman / SC / ST Shareholding
ITR and Financial Net Worth Statement
key_benefits: Loans from ₹10 Lakhs up to ₹1 Crore
Composite loan covering both Plant Machinery & Working Capital
Repayable in 7 years with up to 18-month moratorium
why_template: Your enterprise meets Stand-Up India criteria for composite loans up to ₹1 Crore with CGSSI backing.

name: MSME Sustainable (ZED) Certification & Technology Grant
summary: Provides 80% subsidy for Micro, 60% for Small, and 50% for Medium enterprises on certification costs, eco-friendly audits, and up to ₹5 Lakhs clean tech support.
documents_needed: Energy / Water Audit Report (for Gold/Diamond tier)
key_benefits: 80% Direct Subsidy on Bronze/Silver/Gold Certification
₹5 Lakhs Financial Assistance for Zero Defect Equipment
0.5% Concession on Bank Loan Interest Rates
why_template: Get 80% subsidy on international quality certification and 0.5% loan interest reduction.

name: CLCSS — Credit Linked Capital Subsidy for Tech Upgradation
summary: 15% upfront capital subsidy for inducting well-established and improved technologies in approved manufacturing and processing sub-sectors.
key_benefits: 15% Direct Upfront Capital Grant up to ₹15 Lakhs
Covers modern digital looms, CNC, packaging, and eco-equipment
Can be combined with state-level capital subsidies
why_template: Modernize equipment and looms with ₹15 Lakhs upfront direct capital subsidy.

name: TReDS — Trade Receivables Discounting System
summary: Electronic auction platform to discount and cash in unpaid corporate/PSU customer invoices within 24-48 hours at competitive market interest rates.
key_benefits: Receive 90-95% Cash Advance within 48 Hours
Zero Collateral Required — Non-recourse financing
Mandatory participation for Central PSUs & large corporates
why_template: Eliminate 60-90 day payment delays by factoring unpaid buyer invoices into cash.

name: Udyam Registration (Prerequisite National Gateway)
authority: Ministry of MSME, Govt of India
summary: Zero-cost official government registration that classifies enterprises as MSMEs and unlocks priority sector lending, lower electricity tariffs, and scheme access.
key_benefits: 100% Free Paperless Registration with Lifetime Validity
Prerequisite for PMEGP, CGTMSE, and Government Tenders
1% to 2% Interest Rate Exemption on Bank Loans
why_template: Essential prerequisite ID for your {category} enterprise to unlock all state and central subsidies.
